page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword "Roy:" at lower right; signature "P 3" at foot left of catchword. No margin notes. Text on the left margin edge of the scan belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: mandat, Marchionem d'Ancre sibi fistat, vivum, mortuum; non interesse : Nec multò pòst prædictus Marchio, fati impendentis ignarus, Parisios contendit, Regem officii gratiâ conventurus: cumque insolitâ pompâ stipatus, Palatio appropinquaret, majores etiam valvas, honoris ergò reseratas habuit. Sed mox in interiore area à Vitrii militibus aliquot sclopetorum glandibus trajicitur, & sine voce aut ejulatu concidit 24. Maji anno 1617. Ubi rumor cædis increbuit, tanta populi exultatio, tantus ad Palatium confluxus, cespitantium hinc inde, & mutuis recursibus turmatim labentium, ut insanire præ gaudio tota simul multitudo videretur. Rex aderat è superiori fenestra civium studia despiciens: Illi festivas non voces, sed vociferationes tollere : Vive le Roy:

page.notes: Printed text is in roman with italic for the final cry. The "P 3" is a signature and "Roy:" the catchword. Some letters in the lower left of the scan are from the adjacent page and omitted.
